name: timeline-playhead-center-lock
title: Center-lock timeline playhead after midpoint
description: Adjust timeline playback follow behavior so the timeline does not scroll before the playhead reaches the viewport center, then scrolls at the same speed as playback to keep the playhead centered.
creator: codex
notes: User feedback rejected edge-zone recentering. Adopt center-lock behavior: target scrollLeft is playheadX minus half the viewport, clamped to scroll bounds, with immediate auto scrolling to match playback speed.
